description_en: Queries the execution status of a log configuration modification task
description_zh: 查询日志配置修改任务的执行状态
name: DescribeTaskDispatchStatus

parameters.help_en:
The task ID. It is the unique identifier of the log configuration modification task. You can obtain the task ID from the TaskId parameter in the response of the ModifySlsDispatchConfig operation.

Note: This parameter is required. If it is not provided, the server returns a 400 error and rejects the request. Make sure to specify a valid TaskId
parameters.help_zh:
任务Id，日志配置修改任务的唯一标识。在ModifySlsDispatchConfig接口的返回值（TaskId）中获取。

注意：本参数在实际调用中为必填项，未提供时服务端会返回 400 错误拒绝请求，请务必传入有效的 TaskId
parameters.name: task_id

Status.description_en: The task status. Valid values: PENDING (pending execution), RUNNING (running), SUCCESS (successful), FAILED (failed), and CANCELLED (canceled)
Status.description_zh: PENDING（待执行）、RUNNING（执行中）、SUCCESS（成功）、FAILED（失败）、CANCELLED（已取消）
